name: Universität Wien Kalender
notes: Server-rendered listing at / (TYPO3/UnivieEvents) paginated 3-6 events per page via a cHash-signed 'Weiter' link that must be followed verbatim (guessing cHash values 404s). Each event's own /einzelansicht detail page carries a full schema.org Event JSON-LD block (start/end/location/description/isAccessibleForFree/eventStatus); category text is only in the detail page's HTML (not in the JSON-LD). Also pulls the homepage's repeating 'Teaser' highlight and the 'Ausstellungen' (exhibitions) sidebar box for long-running shows that may not surface in the paginated day list. price_min only set to 0.0 when isAccessibleForFree is literally true; otherwise null (no price field exists in the LD+JSON). city comes from address.addressLocality verbatim (many events are off-site, e.g. Salzburg) rather than assumed Wien.
